reserveReview.rationale: At finalized Solana slot 462444855 (block time 2026-10-28T10:36:45Z; observed 2026-10-28T10:36:45.986Z), one getMultipleAccounts response covered all 33 reviewed accounts, including the complete SDK pair inventory, two LST headers and vaults, all active exogenous vaults, USDC, hyUSD supply and five Pyth price accounts. The accounts measured 226,446.085483504 jitoSOL at 1.307267444 SOL each, 21,679.335930694 hyloSOL at 1.081731677 SOL each, 41.57701554 cbBTC, 26,258.208405277 HYPE, 0.00104739 ZEC and 0.036936 USDC. Fully verified Pyth observations published at 2026-10-28T10:36:44Z valued SOL/BTC/HYPE/ZEC/USDC at $102.99443135/$81,429.7495982/$82.09281943/$1,313.43852276/$0.99969857. Gross collateral totals $38,445,551.121644445. Pool liabilities total 24,202,936.268997 hyUSD against mint supply 24,202,914.594102, a 21.674895 difference within the existing 24.202914594102 tolerance. ZEC is paused; ONYC, PST and WETH pair accounts are absent. The capture establishes held-token identity and valuation, not ZEC issuer, bridge or custody guarantees.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Single finalized Solana account census with SDK v2.0.5 layouts, derived vault identities, current LST SOL conversions, same-slot fully verified Pyth SOL/USD, BTC/USD, HYPE/USD, ZEC/USD and USDC/USD prices, and pool-liability reconciliation to the hyUSD mint
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The complete reviewed SDK inventory contains two LST headers, cbBTC/HYPE/ZEC exogenous pools and USDC; the three other SDK candidates remain absent. ZEC issuer, bridge and underlying custody are unverified and omitted from its classification. Its observed paused state remains adverse. Identified cryptoasset pools have no tracked stablecoin dependency.
